body.name: Deterministic discrete-sine fallback frame
body.construction:
For \(1\le i\le n\) and \(1\le k\le r\), set
\[
 (U^{\mathrm F})_{ik}=\sqrt{\frac{2}{n+1}}
 \sin\!\left(\frac{\pi ik}{n+1}\right).
\]
Thus \(U^{\mathrm F}\) is the matrix formed by the first \(r\) columns of the type-I \(n\)-dimensional discrete-sine matrix.
inputs: The row dimension and target rank.
